# === Import ===

--8<-- [start:import]
-import_from(py.torch_distributions, [distribution, make_distribution,
    sample, log_prob, entropy, mean, variance, stddev, cdf, icdf])
--8<-- [end:import]


# === Distribution Registry ===

--8<-- [start:distribution]
distribution(NAME, CLASS)
--8<-- [end:distribution]

--8<-- [start:distribution_ex2]
findall(N, distribution(N, _), NS),
in_("Normal", NS)
--8<-- [end:distribution_ex2]


# === Construction ===

--8<-- [start:make_distribution]
make_distribution(NAME, PARAMS, DIST)
--8<-- [end:make_distribution]

--8<-- [start:make_distribution_ex2]
make_distribution("Normal", {"loc": 0.0, "scale": 1.0}, D)
--8<-- [end:make_distribution_ex2]

--8<-- [start:make_distribution_ex3]
make_distribution("Categorical", {"probs": [0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25]}, D)
--8<-- [end:make_distribution_ex3]


# === Properties ===

--8<-- [start:mean_variance_stddev]
mean(DIST, M)
variance(DIST, V)
stddev(DIST, S)
--8<-- [end:mean_variance_stddev]

--8<-- [start:mean_variance_stddev_ex2]
make_distribution("Normal", {"loc": 2.0, "scale": 1.0}, D),
mean(D, M),
tensor_list(M, 2.0)
--8<-- [end:mean_variance_stddev_ex2]

--8<-- [start:entropy]
entropy(DIST, H)
--8<-- [end:entropy]


# === Sampling ===

--8<-- [start:sample]
sample(DIST, S)
sample(DIST, SHAPE, S)
--8<-- [end:sample]

--8<-- [start:sample_ex2]
make_distribution("Normal", {"loc": 0.0, "scale": 1.0}, D),
sample(D, [100], S),
shape(S, [100])
--8<-- [end:sample_ex2]


# === Log Probability ===

--8<-- [start:log_prob]
log_prob(DIST, VALUE, LP)
--8<-- [end:log_prob]

--8<-- [start:log_prob_ex2]
make_distribution("Normal", {"loc": 0.0, "scale": 1.0}, D),
tensor(0.0, V),
log_prob(D, V, LP)
--8<-- [end:log_prob_ex2]


# === CDF / Inverse CDF ===

--8<-- [start:cdf]
cdf(DIST, VALUE, PROB)
--8<-- [end:cdf]

--8<-- [start:icdf]
icdf(DIST, PROB, VALUE)
--8<-- [end:icdf]

--8<-- [start:cdf_icdf_roundtrip]
make_distribution("Normal", {"loc": 0.0, "scale": 1.0}, D),
tensor(0.5, V),
cdf(D, V, P),
icdf(D, P, V2),
allclose(V, V2)
--8<-- [end:cdf_icdf_roundtrip]
